move_in.label: Full Name
move_in.prompt: What is your full name, exactly as it appears on your government ID?

move_in.label: Unit Number
move_in.prompt: Which unit/apartment number are you moving into? (e.g. B-204)

move_in.label: Government ID Proof
move_in.prompt: Please provide your government-issued ID proof. Reply with the file name, including its extension (e.g. aadhaar_card.pdf or passport.jpg) - "no"/"none" won't be accepted, this document is required.

move_in.label: Signed Lease Agreement
move_in.prompt: Please provide your signed lease agreement document. Reply with the file name, including its extension (e.g. lease_signed.pdf).

move_in.label: Move-in Date
move_in.prompt: What is your planned move-in date? Use YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-09-01).

move_in.label: Vehicle Registration
move_in.prompt: Do you have a vehicle you'll be parking in the community? Share the vehicle registration number (e.g. KA-01-AB-1234), or type "none" if you don't have one.

move_out.label: Full Name
move_out.prompt: What is your full name, exactly as it appears on your government ID?

move_out.label: Unit Number
move_out.prompt: Which unit/apartment number are you moving out of? (e.g. B-204)

move_out.label: Move-out Date
move_out.prompt: What is your planned move-out date? Use YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-09-01).

move_out.label: Government ID Proof
move_out.prompt: Please provide your government ID for verification. Reply with the file name, including its extension (e.g. aadhaar_card.pdf) - "no"/"none" won't be accepted, this document is required.

move_out.label: Forwarding Address
move_out.prompt: What is your forwarding address (street, city, postal code), for mail and deposit refund purposes?

move_out.label: Move-out Condition Acknowledgement
move_out.prompt: Do you confirm the unit will be left in good, inspection-ready condition on your move-out date? (Yes/No)
